data.name: Reports_Common_DateRangeSubtitle
data.comment: {DateFrom} range start, {DateTo} range end — both already formatted 'd MMMM yyyy'.

data.name: Reports_Common_PartYearSubtitle
data.comment: Wraps a financial-statement subtitle when the default FY-preset period is an organisation's sub-twelve-month first financial year (FR-022 / issue #353). {Period} is the already-formatted date-range or as-at subtitle.

data.name: Reports_Common_BasisOfAccounting
data.value: Rechnungslegungsgrundlage: Mitgliedsbeiträge werden bei Vorschreibung erfasst (Periodenabgrenzung); alle übrigen Erträge und Aufwendungen werden bei Zahlungseingang bzw. -ausgang erfasst (Ist-Rechnung).
data.comment: Hybrid basis-of-accounting disclosure shown on every financial statement (FR-012). Must name both the accrual treatment of member fees and the cash treatment of other activity — never a single blanket basis.

data.name: Reports_MemberList_SubTitle
data.comment: {Status} selected status-filter value, {Date} generation date formatted 'd MMMM yyyy'.

data.name: Reports_Committee_SubTitle
data.comment: {Filter} selected member-status filter value, {Date} generation date formatted 'd MMMM yyyy'.

data.name: Reports_Committee_Present
data.comment: Shown as the end date for a currently-serving committee member in a dated holder list.

data.name: Reports_IncomeStatement_SubTitleCompare
data.comment: All four tokens are dates already formatted 'd MMMM yyyy': current range start/end, then prior range start/end.

data.name: Reports_TrialBalance_GLImbalanceError
data.value: Prüfung des Hauptbuchsaldos fehlgeschlagen: Die Summe der Sollbeträge ({Debits}) entspricht nicht der Summe der Habenbeträge ({Credits}). Jede Differenz ist ein Fehler — die Rohbilanz kann nicht erstellt werden, solange das Hauptbuch nicht ausgeglichen ist.
data.comment: {Debits}/{Credits} are the GL totals pre-formatted through MoneyFormatter and already carry the configured currency symbol.

data.name: Reports_BalanceSheet_SubTitle
data.comment: {Date} report date formatted 'd MMMM yyyy'.

data.name: Reports_BalanceSheet_OutOfBalance
data.comment: Label on the explicit out-of-balance line appended when total assets do not equal total liabilities plus equity (FR-010). The adjacent cell shows the signed difference.

data.name: Reports_BankReconciliation_SubTitle
data.value: Aktuellste Abstimmung pro Konto, erstellt am {Date}
data.comment: {Date} generation date formatted 'd MMMM yyyy'.

data.name: Reports_BankReconciliation_AccountHeader
data.comment: {Account} account name, {Number} account number, {StatementDate} formatted 'd MMMM yyyy', {Status} localised reconciliation status.

data.name: Reports_BankReconciliation_BalancePerBankStatement
data.comment: First line of the conventional adjusted-balance reconciliation — the closing balance printed on the bank statement (FR-013).

data.name: Reports_BankReconciliation_AddOutstandingDeposits
data.comment: Subtotal label for deposits recorded in the ledger but not yet on the bank statement; the amount is added to the statement balance (FR-014).

data.name: Reports_BankReconciliation_LessOutstandingPayments
data.comment: Subtotal label for payments recorded in the ledger but not yet cleared by the bank; the amount is deducted from the statement balance (FR-014).

data.name: Reports_BankReconciliation_AdjustedBankBalance
data.comment: Statement balance plus outstanding deposits less outstanding payments.

data.name: Reports_BankReconciliation_BalancePerGeneralLedger
data.comment: The account's net general-ledger balance as at the statement date (FR-013).

data.name: Reports_BankReconciliation_Reconciled
data.value: Abgestimmt (angepasster Banksaldo abzüglich Saldo laut Hauptbuch)
data.comment: Residual between the adjusted bank balance and the general-ledger balance; zero on a reconciled statement (SC-008).

data.name: Reports_ChartOfAccounts_NameSystemBank
data.comment: {Name} account name; the parenthetical marks a system bank account.

data.name: Reports_ChartOfAccounts_NameSystem
data.comment: {Name} account name; the parenthetical marks a system account.

data.name: Reports_ChartOfAccounts_NameBank
data.comment: {Name} account name; the parenthetical marks a bank account.

data.name: Reports_ChartOfAccounts_BalanceError
data.comment: Shown in the Balance column when an account balance could not be computed.

data.value: Umsatzsteuer gilt für diese Organisation nicht. Aktivieren Sie die Umsatzsteuer in den Einstellungen, um eine Steuerübersicht zu erstellen.

data.comment: {Date} AGM date formatted 'd MMMM yyyy'. Shared by the AGM Results sheet and the AGM Attendance Report sheet.

data.name: Reports_AgmResults_AttendanceLine
data.comment: {Attended} number of members who attended, {Total} total member count.

data.name: Reports_AgmResults_PositionLabel
data.comment: {Label} elected position title; this segment renders bold and is immediately followed by the elected member name(s). Trailing space is significant.
